---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea, generic knowledge model, or methodology enhancement.
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of what the problem is (e.g., "I find it difficult to analyze multi-modal tactile feedback...").

**Describe the Solution You'd Like**
A clear and concise description of the generic methodology, heuristics card, or reference document you would like added to the Public Core.

**Epistemic & Scientific Basis**
Please provide academic or standard citations (Author, Year, DOI, or ISO/ANSI standard) supporting this methodology. Note: Proprietary enterprise guidelines cannot be accepted into the Public Core.
